title: Model-based Counterfactual Generator for Gender Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Measured extrinsically by calculating True Positive Rate Difference (TPRD) and False Positive Rate Difference (FPRD) between male and female text instances on downstream classification tasks (job prediction and toxicity detection). It is also measured intrinsically using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to evaluate the cosine similarity between gender words and target stereotype words in word embeddings.
